scope.layout: native packed input and output slabs only
scope.fallback: all other counts, byte sizes, backends, fields, and valid layouts retain the mature encoder

corrected_attribution.invalid_prior_condition: An older campaign inherited OMP_PLACES=cores and is not used for any performance conclusion.
corrected_attribution.conclusion: The exact T16/64-byte cell was a real Leopard2 regression, while larger-K T16 behavior was mixed rather than uniformly slower.

implementation.description: The generated kernel executes the same legacy T16 radix-four inverse and forward butterflies, but keeps each outer column in registers across its adjacent inverse and forward groups.
implementation.structural_win: Removes one complete 16-shard memory round without changing field representation, butterfly order, coordinate order, or parity bytes.
implementation.layout_isolation: The kernel is linked as a trailing AVX2-only object. An earlier in-TU prototype was rejected because code placement regressed neighboring transforms.
implementation.runtime_selection: The public terminal proves exact K=R=T=16, B=64, GF8, AVX2, legacy-high, native packed and non-overlapping geometry before writing output.

authoritative_method.interval: two-sided Student-t 95% interval over paired per-round log ratios

target_speedups.ratio_semantics: numerator encode time divided by generated-candidate encode time; values above one favor the candidate

neighbor_guard.ratio_semantics: predecessor time divided by candidate time; a lower confidence bound below 0.98 would permit a regression greater than two percent

reproduction.tests: env OMP_DYNAMIC=FALSE OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 OMP_THREAD_LIMIT=1 OMP_PROC_BIND=TRUE ctest --test-dir build/t16-avx2 -j1 --output-on-failure -R 'leopard2_balanced_b64_terminal(_production)?$'
reproduction.candidate_target: env -u OMP_PLACES OMP_DYNAMIC=FALSE OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 OMP_THREAD_LIMIT=1 OMP_PROC_BIND=TRUE taskset -c 13 build/t16-avx2/bench_leopard2 --k 16 --r 16 --bytes 64 --loss 1 --batch 1 --reuse 8192 --iterations 21 --warmup 32 --threads 1 --profile high --field gf8 --backend avx2 --skip-legacy --retain-samples --attest-source --balanced-b64-terminal-mode 1 --json candidate.json
reproduction.same_binary_control: Repeat candidate_target with --balanced-b64-terminal-mode 0 and the same seed, then pair invocation order and reserve SMT sibling 29.
